## What's new

Threadnote 5.2.0-beta.1 brings GitHub, Linear, Pocket, and Superhuman Docs into recall, keeps source evidence with derived memories, and adds guided memory consolidation and conflict review.

### Bring connected work into recall

- **GitHub:** connect selected repositories to recall issues, pull request descriptions, conversation comments, submitted reviews, and inline review threads with their source links and review context.
- **Linear · Beta:** connect explicitly selected teams and projects or issues to recall requirements, threaded discussions, project overviews, documents, and updates. The integration keeps the configured selection and access boundaries in place.
- **Pocket:** automatically discover accessible recordings and import their transcripts, summaries, and related text. Later syncs pick up new recordings and summaries that have finished processing.
- **Superhuman Docs:** import selected documents and canvas pages through a read-only connection. Manager restores saved document and page selections with their current titles, links, and icons.

Manager now separates **Your connections** from a searchable **Available integrations** catalog. Set up connections, inspect sync progress, pause access, or disconnect from one place. These integrations read source content without changing it.

### Keep recall moving while sources refresh

Recall requests background refresh and immediately searches eligible local snapshots. CLI, MCP, and Manager share one on-demand sync coordinator, with bounded work, shared provider rate limits, and progress that survives restarts. Obsidian uses this flow too.

Use Manager's **Sync now** or `threadnote source sync <id> --apply` to wait for an explicit sync result. Paused, removed, expired, or access-denied content stays unavailable to recall and direct reads.

### Keep the evidence behind a memory

- Derive a private memory from a reviewed Obsidian note or imported GitHub, Linear, Pocket, or Superhuman Docs fragment while retaining the exact sanitized evidence that supported it.
- Inspect that historical support with `read_source_evidence`, alongside whether the current source revision is the same, changed, removed, or unknown. Source changes do not silently rewrite the derived memory.
- Retained evidence follows current local access controls and expires after 90 days by default, with configurable retention from 1 to 365 days. Removing a source also removes its retained evidence.

### Consolidate memories with reviewed support

Select memories in Library and choose **Consolidate** to generate and review a draft. Choose an installed local AI model, an available Codex or Claude model, or a configured remote provider; local generation stays on your computer.

Review each paragraph's supporting fragments, citations, and relations before applying it. The saved result preserves selected direct support and private derivation history. Changed drafts require a new review, changed sources block stale saves, and interrupted source cleanup can resume from the saved result.

### Review context conflicts with clearer evidence

- Context Health compares supported claims with their environment, workspace, validity period, units, and required-versus-observed meaning. Equivalent measurements and compatible constraints can coexist; conflicting claims show their original statements and scope.
- Manager lets you keep either memory or both after reviewing a preview. Keeping one archives the entire other memory with its original body and provenance. Keeping both records a decision for those exact revisions; source edits reopen the review.
- Background semantic scans resume across record and claim limits and process restarts. Manager distinguishes extraction, comparison, unsupported content, and omitted findings so partial coverage stays visible. The analyzer remains a bounded English heuristic and never chooses a winner automatically.
- Citation maintenance refreshes exact cases safely, and citation metadata errors explain the affected field more clearly.

### A smoother Manager workspace

- The project selector defaults to **All**. Home gathers context across projects with provenance, Reviews keep each item's project, and Context Health starts with clickable project tiles.
- Graph administration scrolls correctly, Explore keeps a usable canvas when filters expand, and spacing stays consistent on narrow screens.
- Graph status exposes background reconciliation progress while keeping controls available. Starting Manager from source reports a missing browser bundle before opening a listener.

Agent guidance also clarifies that explicit deferred citation writes require code references and an active memory; inactive records use strict citation capture.
